_about: B5 batch glossary (concepts/subagents-and-delegation, concepts/jobs-workflow-goal-plan). Owner: B5 writer. Searched core.json, b2.json, b4.json first; subagent, job, workflow, goal and plan-mode already exist in core.json and are reused with {{term ...}}.

subagent-provider.short: A named backend registered on ctx.subagents. A parent picks one by name; providers differ in whether the child keeps a session.
subagent-provider.long: Method presence selects the family: prepareContinuable() gives a local, durable child; a provider with only start() runs once ({{cite packages/subagent/subagent/src/types.ts:313-356}}).

tool-restriction.short: An allow and/or deny mask on the global tools one scoped agent can see, set with ctx.tools.restrict().
tool-restriction.long: {{cite packages/core/tools/src/contracts.ts:376-381}}. Restrictions from different scopes intersect; a scope's own registrations stay visible ({{cite packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:162-189}}).
